ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Believe in? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Believe in with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Believe in.
   C. Say Believe in has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Believe in to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of care for plants? (1 mark)
   A. Use care for plants to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing care for plants.
   C. Apply the teaching of care for plants with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say care for plants has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Selected surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected surah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Selected surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Honesty? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on:Honesty has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on:Honesty to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Honesty.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Honesty with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: responsibility? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on: responsibility to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: responsibility with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: responsibility.
   D. Say Hadith on: responsibility has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Environment? (1 mark)
   A. Say Environment has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Environment.
   C. Use Environment to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Environment with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of.
   B. Use Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on:Ihsaan 4.0 HADITH (Traditions of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick.
   C. Use Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on: Respect? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on: Respect to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on: Respect.
   C. Say Hadith on: Respect has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: Respect with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Pillars of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of.
   C. Say Pillars of has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Pillars of to insult classmates of other faiths.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Early life of the prophet? (1 mark)
   A. Use Early life of the prophet to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Early life of the prophet with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Early life of the prophet.
   D. Say Early life of the prophet has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on:Honesty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on: Respect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on: responsibility and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship 6.2.1 care and dua for the sick and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
